name: Blood Orchid
description: A carnivorous bloom cultivated in the old infirmary. It turns toward a wounded traveler with the patient attention of a nurse.

abilities.description: Restores up to 5 health once after a response that damages player health, if still alive.
Restores up to 2 health after its response if still alive, capped at maximum health.
